patch.value: GH-794: make copied identity output_format overrides decline instead of exposing the host envelope

An output_format service override that shallow-copies and returns its input claims the host wrapper and replaces every command output with internal global/format/options/result fields. Extend the public SDK decision contract so semantic identity is safe, typed, and diagnosable.

Reference-identical and semantically identical output payloads decline safely; intentional handled output remains possible through ServiceOverrideDecision; output_format payload and replacement semantics are typed and documented; pm-ts-starter cannot corrupt list or health envelopes; isolated installed-package regressions cover JSON and TOON
Make SDK output override ownership safe for natural identity implementations
Package authors can customize output without silently breaking every agent consumer
